risk_note: Story P1 with task 2 in P0; the gate is run as for P0.

threshold_source.note: No specs/tech-architecture/e25-TEST_PLAN_LATEST.md exists; the thresholds are the four the story spec states, grouped under the gate's three dimensions.

environment.model: omlx/qwen3.8-27b-oq8e, omlx/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-MLX-oQ4-MTP and omlx-b/qwen3.8-27b-oq8e (the same endpoint and weights under a second provider name), through an isolated PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR

performance.threshold: Session opened, model selected by /model, then /495 start: 0 capability refusals
performance.measured: Campaign e25s02-en-route (chg_muemb8qe300ab3f5ec): opened on Flash-Next, qwen3.8-27b-oq8e selected after the session was replaced, 0 refusals, accepted G0..G5 in 9 min 20 s. The negative control on main (e25s02-en-route-negatif) refuses the same sequence with capability_missing on the opening model.
performance.note: A session opened with no model at all is held by test/v3/model-select.test.ts only. The story reads one context property per intervention, so no latency is added on the path it touches.

reliability.threshold: Two interventions separated by a model change: 2 starts journaled, 2 different models, each the one selected at its start. A change between the capability check and the worker start: the model journaled and handed to the worker is the one judged
reliability.measured: e25s02-en-route: specify started under omlx/qwen3.8-27b-oq8e; prepare and implement under omlx-b/qwen3.8-27b-oq8e, selected 0.4 s after specify started. Each worker's cost line names the model it resolved: omlx for specify, omlx-b for the other two, so the running intervention kept its model. e25s02-flash-refuse: the model selected, Flash-Next, is the one judged and refused, and no worker started.
reliability.note: The window between the capability check and the worker start is held by test/v3/model-select.test.ts; no campaign can hit it on purpose.

operability.threshold: Session replaced, then a model selected in the replacing session: the next intervention starts with that model
operability.measured: All four campaigns replace the session with new_session before selecting. On the branch, the model selected afterwards is the one employed (e25s02-en-route) or judged (e25s02-flash-refuse). On main, the model the replacing session opened on is employed or judged instead (e25s02-negatif, e25s02-en-route-negatif).
operability.note: The model frontier is read from the ledger by difference between two intervention.started events; no new event is journaled, as §12 states.
